newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki stumbles as Intel warning knocks Nokia.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki stumbles as Intel warning knocks Nokia.

text.p: Shares bumped down, a fall gaining pace just before the close on Friday after a profit warning from U.S. computer chipmaker Intel hit Nokia and set a bearish stage for next week, brokers said.
"We'll go into next week in very unpleasant circumstances," said one broker after the FOX stock futures index fell by 1.5 percent. "There have been very few buy stories in recent days."

After thin, mildly weaker trade for most of the session, Nokia A pitched down as Intel said its second-quarter results would be disappointing. Nokia ended 12.30 markka down at 336.20 with volume in both series mounting to 320 million markka.
Nokia pulled other stocks down in what was an otherwise featureless session. Banking shares fell despite a credit upgrade from European rating agency IBCA for Merita, OKOBANK and Postipankki.
Merita ended 0.10 markka lower at 17.60, but off a session low of 17.40, after sturdy 49 million markka trade. OKOBANK fell 3.00 markka to 70.00 in thin volume.
Forestries also closed lower. UPM-Kymmene fell 0.10 markka to 118.20 in hefty 73 million markka volume. Enso dropped 2.20 marrka to 45.50 in sturdy 14 million markka trade.
